why: Not a separate place: ReserveAmerica park 234151 loop LAKE VIEW (read 2026-11-05) puts its 8 sites (045-052, GIS centroid 40.15086,-101.06823) 0.48 km from the nearest Spring Canyon site (042) and 0.72 km from Spring Canyon's site centroid, on a short spur off the same SRA access road that serves Spring Canyon (Esri World Imagery, rendered 2026-11-05) - under the ~1 km / own-entrance bar, so it is covered by 2741 Swanson Reservoir SRA - Spring Canyon Campground (whose pin is only 0.43 km away).
name: Swanson Reservoir SRA - Lake View loop
flags: Duplicate of 2741 (Spring Canyon). Separation measured from RA GIS points: Lake View 045-052 centroid 40.15086,-101.06823; Spring Canyon's 25 RA sites centroid 40.14520,-101.07230; nearest pair 045 vs 042 = 0.48 km. Satellite shows the Lake View spur branching north off the main SRA road ~300 m east of Spring Canyon's north end; no separate entrance.

2741's pin (40.14966,-101.06342) looks mis-placed: it sits on the dam / Hwy 25 junction east of the campground, 0.90 km from Spring Canyon's RA site centroid (40.14520,-101.07230) and closer to Lake View (0.43 km) than to its own pads. Worth re-pinning when 2741 is next touched.

Facts for 2741's note/booking if AWH wants Lake View folded in: RA lists 8 Lake View sites 045-052, all 'Basic' (no electric attribute), Drive-In, Back-In, Max Vehicle Length 40, Driveway Grade Slight, 'Driveway Surface: Grass' on every site page (RA, read 2026-11-05); RA calendar shows them walk-up ('W') through Apr 30 2027 and reservable ('A') from May 1 2027, 180-day window, 1 day ahead (RA Swanson SRA facility page). NGPC's Swanson page (Wayback 2026-08-18) and the 2024 brochure do not name Lake View; the brochure's Spring Canyon inset shows sites 1-42 only.

Sand caveat: Esri World Imagery (rendered 2026-11-05) shows the Lake View pads along the tree edge of the open sand beach at the SE corner of the lake just west of the dam's south end (two, 045/046, out on the open sand near the point), although RA calls every driveway grass. If ever added on its own it would need the open-beach sand rule applied; as a 2741 sub-loop it changes nothing.

2741's booking note says 'RA lists 25 Spring Canyon sites (23 electric, 2 basic)': confirmed 2026-11-05 (020 and 021 have no Electricity Hookup attribute; all others 50, all Max Vehicle Length 40). NGPC still says 47 Spring Canyon pads; the 2016 NGPC map shows 1-37 plus 20A/20B, the 2024 brochure 1-42.
